roles.name: Member 1 - Frontend and reporting experience
roles.mission: Build a clear phone-friendly journey from photo and location to human review, publication and an editable complaint.
roles.reviewer: Member 4 reviews usability; Member 2 reviews API integration.

tasks.title: Agree on screens and API contracts
steps: Read lib/contracts.ts with M2; agree on upload, analyzing, review, publishing, success and error states.
Sketch these states for app/page.tsx; agree with M4 on selected-location and after-publish callbacks.
tasks.done: Team agrees on payloads, labels, mandatory human confirmation and map callbacks before coding.
tasks.handoff: M2 provides contracts/session helper; M4 confirms map props.

tasks.title: Build the reporting page shell
steps: In app/page.tsx and components/report/ReportWorkspace.tsx, create a phone-first page with labeled steps and visible progress.
Keep browser APIs in the client workspace; reserve a client-only dynamic map slot for M4 with SSR disabled.
tasks.done: Page opens locally and on the initial HTTPS deployment without hydration or window errors.
tasks.handoff: M4 receives the map slot; M2 deploys the shared branch.

tasks.title: Add camera, file selection and preview
steps: Create components/report/PhotoInput.tsx with camera/file inputs, preview, replacement and clear supported-format guidance.
Accept JPEG/PNG/WebP, reject sources over 8 MB, and resize/compress to at most 1600 px and 3 MB before submission; show a useful error if this fails.
tasks.done: Phone photo and file uploads preview correctly; unsupported and oversized files cannot proceed.
tasks.handoff: M2 receives the compressed image; server still validates and strips metadata.

tasks.title: Let users confirm the location
steps: In components/report/LocationStep.tsx, request browser location only after the user taps the location button.
Connect M4's picker; allow tap/drag correction and manual pin selection when permission is denied or location is unavailable.
tasks.done: Confirmed valid coordinates are visible; denying GPS permission still allows completing a report.
tasks.handoff: Depends on M4-04; pass confirmed latitude/longitude to M2's draft route.

tasks.title: Submit a private draft reliably
steps: In ReportWorkspace.tsx, obtain M2's anonymous session and POST multipart image, coordinates, optional note and client_request_id with the bearer token.
Disable repeat clicks; retain the same UUID and values for timeout retries. A new-report action creates a new UUID.
tasks.done: H6 mocked slice receives a draft; errors preserve inputs and never display false submission success.
tasks.handoff: M2 supplies idempotent draft route; M3's mock responses remain visibly sample data.

tasks.title: Build mandatory human review
steps: Create components/report/ReviewPanel.tsx showing the photo, visible-cue evidence, analysis source and editable labels/location.
Allow multiple pollution labels; make unclear/no_visible_pollution exclusive. Require explicit confirmation before publishing; manual fallback starts as unclear.
tasks.done: User can correct AI output; unchecked confirmation blocks publication and no confidence or safety claim is shown.
tasks.handoff: M3 checks label/evidence wording; M2 validates the same rules server-side.

tasks.title: Publish the reviewed draft
steps: Wire ReviewPanel.tsx to PATCH /api/reports/{id} with action=publish, edited labels/location and the bearer token.
Show success only after the response; pass the published report to the workspace and trigger M4's immediate map refresh.
tasks.done: One reviewed draft becomes one published report; failed publication retains edits; mock reports enter only the sample view.
tasks.handoff: M2 updates the existing row; M4 verifies the new marker and count.

tasks.title: Add editable complaint copy and download
steps: Create components/complaint/ComplaintDraft.tsx using the server's safe complaint_text after publication.
Allow local editing, Copy and Download .txt; explain that the user verifies the recipient and sends the complaint separately.
tasks.done: Both export actions work; private notes/contact details are absent from the public template and local edits stay local.
tasks.handoff: M2 supplies deterministic wording; M4 includes this screen in the H12 complete-flow gate.

tasks.title: Make recovery paths understandable
steps: Check report components for denied GPS, canceled selection, invalid images, draft failure, vision timeout and failed publication.
Add concise recovery instructions, retained inputs and safe Retry/New report actions; distinguish AI fallback from failed draft creation.
tasks.done: Each failure has a usable next action; retries cannot silently create duplicate submissions.
tasks.handoff: M4 records failures; M2/M3 resolve backend or adapter problems.

tasks.title: Check phone layout and accessibility
steps: Check report/complaint components at 360 px width and with keyboard navigation; fix clipped controls and misplaced focus.
Use text labels, readable contrast and status announcements; keep sample badges and the visual-suggestion explanation visible.
tasks.done: All required actions work without hover, color-only meaning or horizontal scrolling on a phone.
tasks.handoff: M4 reviews the complete phone journey; M2 merges the verified frontend changes.

tasks.title: Run the deployed photo-to-complaint journey
steps: On the deployed HTTPS URL, capture/select a real photo, confirm a pin, review labels, publish and copy/download the complaint.
Repeat a denied-location or AI-fallback path; fix frontend defects and send screenshots/results to M4 for docs/demo.md.
tasks.done: M4 witnesses a successful phone flow and a recoverable failure; published data appears on a second browser.
tasks.handoff: M2 checks deployed API/session behavior; M4 collects final acceptance evidence.

tasks.title: Freeze the frontend and hand off the demo
steps: Merge reviewed frontend fixes; verify the final deployment and rehearse the photo, review and complaint steps with M4.
Update the M1 GitHub Issue checkboxes with evidence links; record any remaining limitation instead of marking it complete.
tasks.done: M1's required tasks are verified, demo controls are stable, and M4 has usable screenshots plus a backup recording.
tasks.handoff: M2 freezes the release; M4 runs the judging demonstration.

roles.name: Member 4 - Map, integration QA and demo coordination
roles.mission: Make published reports visible on a clear map, verify the end-to-end flow and keep GitHub progress and the demo accurate.
roles.reviewer: Member 1 reviews map usability; Member 2 reviews data handling and integration.

tasks.title: Set up the team's GitHub tracker
steps: After the team creates its repository, copy the supplied role checklists into four GitHub Issues; replace @member1-4 placeholders with real teammates.
Assign owners and add Todo, In progress, Blocked, Review and Done project statuses; link blockers and pull requests.
tasks.done: Every member has an assigned Issue and can tick its tasks; the team knows repository Markdown requires editing/committing.
tasks.handoff: All members use Issues as the task record; PDF boxes do not synchronize.

tasks.title: Agree on map inputs and hotspot rules
steps: Review public report fields with M2 and picker/refresh callbacks with M1; record agreements in docs/demo.md.
Fix the demo center/reference latitude and agree on approximate 100 m projected bins, trailing 24-hour timestamps and separate real/sample counts.
tasks.done: Team agrees that three published pollution report records form a hotspot; records are not verified independent observations.
tasks.handoff: M2 supplies public report fixtures; M1 supplies the client-only map mount.

tasks.title: Render the client-only Leaflet map
steps: Build components/map/MapView.tsx with React Leaflet, Leaflet CSS and OpenStreetMap tiles; keep attribution visible.
Show the chosen demo area, clear marker colors/labels and an honest empty state; default to real reports.
tasks.done: Map loads in M1's workspace without SSR errors, and attribution stays readable on a phone.
tasks.handoff: M1 imports MapView through the agreed client-only wrapper.

tasks.title: Build the location picker
steps: Create components/map/LocationPicker.tsx with tap-to-place and draggable pin behavior; emit validated latitude/longitude through the agreed callback.
Accept M1's browser-location result for recentering and keep the selected pin visibly distinct from published markers.
tasks.done: M1 can select and correct a location without GPS; selecting a pin alone never creates a public report.
tasks.handoff: Unblocks M1-04; M1 stores the confirmed coordinates.

tasks.title: Fetch and refresh published reports
steps: In components/map/useReports.ts, use production-shaped fixtures until M2 provides GET /api/reports; fetch on load and after M1's publish callback.
Poll every 10 seconds while visible, refresh on return, and clean up timers; show loading, error and last-successful-update states.
tasks.done: Production-shaped fixtures verify refresh and stale/error states; M4-08 verifies live second-browser updates after M2 delivers GET.
tasks.handoff: M2 guarantees published-only safe fields and fresh signed image URLs; describe this as polling.

tasks.title: Calculate report-density hotspots
steps: Implement the frozen projected-bin formula in lib/hotspots.ts; count each eligible published record once and split real/sample datasets.
Check threshold, multilabel, time-boundary and neutral-label cases in tests/e2e/hotspots.spec.ts; show the H6 mocked map slice.
tasks.done: Three recent pollution records in one bin trigger a hotspot; unclear/no_visible_pollution, old or cross-layer records cannot inflate it.
tasks.handoff: M2 reviews timestamp/filter logic; M1 reviews the report-density wording.

tasks.title: Make sample data unmistakable
steps: Add separate real and Sample demo views in MapView.tsx; label sample markers, popup details and hotspot counts clearly.
Use only M2's server seed flow for demonstration fixtures; verify mock analysis reports appear exclusively in the sample view.
tasks.done: Switching views never combines counts; sample activity cannot be mistaken for real public reports.
tasks.handoff: M2 controls demo insertion; M3 provides labeled mock fixtures; M1 displays matching source badges.

tasks.title: Pass the complete-flow integration gate
steps: Exercise photo to draft to human review to publish to map to complaint; record the result in docs/demo.md.
Verify drafts stay hidden, publication keeps one report ID, immediate refresh works, and a second browser receives the report through polling.
tasks.done: H12 deployed flow works with real vision. Record labeled manual/mock contingency if needed, but leave the live gate unmet.
tasks.handoff: Route blockers to M1/M2/M3 immediately; defer visual polish until this gate passes.

tasks.title: Verify ownership and public-data boundaries
steps: With M2, use two anonymous sessions to verify one owner cannot edit/publish the other's draft and unauthenticated writes fail.
Check public JSON excludes owner IDs, raw image_path fields and private notes; confirm private storage cannot be listed/read directly.
tasks.done: Record passing checks in docs/demo.md and useful regressions in tests/e2e/report-flow.spec.ts; no credentials appear in evidence.
tasks.handoff: M2 fixes authorization/storage issues before the release gate.

tasks.title: Test failures and phone map behavior
steps: Check slow/failed vision, duplicate retries, denied location, empty results, network loss and signed-photo URL refresh; log defects in GitHub Issues.
Test map controls/popups at phone width, attribution, sample badges and polling cleanup when hidden or unmounted.
tasks.done: Required failure paths recover without fabricated success or duplicate counts; unresolved demo blockers have owners.
tasks.handoff: M1 fixes UX, M2 fixes requests/data, M3 fixes adapter failures; M4 retests the fixes.

tasks.title: Rehearse the map-fill demonstration
steps: Write docs/demo.md with a three-minute script: photo, reviewed visual suggestion, new marker, report-density hotspot and copied complaint.
Rehearse with all members; use a clearly labeled sample view for staged map filling and explain that refresh uses 10-second polling.
tasks.done: Everyone knows their speaking/action cue; live behavior and sample scenes are distinguishable, with a recorded backup available.
tasks.handoff: M1 operates reporting screens; M2 monitors deployment; M3 explains vision limits; M4 narrates the map.

tasks.title: Close verified tasks and freeze the demo
steps: Run final phone and second-browser checks on M2's release URL; save commit hash, screenshots, video and known limitations in docs/demo.md.
Tick verified Issue tasks, link evidence and move reviewed work to Done; leave unfinished items open and rehearse the backup switch.
tasks.done: The judging URL, release version, checked task evidence and honest backup demo are accessible to all four teammates.
tasks.handoff: All members stop feature work; optional H24-36 improvements start only after acceptance passes.
